notes.title: 1 year anniversary update
notes.content:
This will probably be final update for the game due to lack of interest. Game have been released for a year and to celebrate this i decided to make one in the life time huge sale because I hope this game can still entertain atleast few people.

Improvements
- Added animated driver.
- There is now 10% chance of rain.
- Minor Lobby logic changes.

notes.title: BUILD 2
notes.content:
Improvements
- First implementation of customization. Lets you change color of your car. Goals will be painted same color as your car.
- Changed map visuals to winter time.
- Added sun flare.
- Added animated steering wheel.
- Added missing engine and exhaust mesh.
- Added body panels to interior.
- Increased angular drag to prevent roll overs.

Fixes
- Fixed name of Host's opponent not appearing.
- Fixed Bounds around corners.
- Fixed terrain chunks boundaries.
- Fixed main menu camera after match ended.
- Fixed glass in mirrors being painted with body color.
